name_input: M/S S M C PNEUMATICS INDIA PVT LTD; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PVT LTD; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED.; SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: SMC is a Japanese pneumatic/automation component maker; the Indian entity is the local sales/manufacturing arm. Product lines verified on the SMC corporate catalogue (smc.eu/en-eu, product taxonomy read directly): (1) Pneumatic actuators — linear/guided/rodless/clamp cylinders, rotary actuators, grippers (HS 8412.31 pneumatic linear actuators; 8412.39 other pneumatic engines/motors); (2) Directional control valves — pilot-operated and direct-operated 3/4/5-port solenoid valves, air-operated, mechanical/hand, NAMUR, safety release valves (HS 8481.20 valves for pneumatic power transmission; 8481.80 other valves); (3) Airline equipment — filters, regulators, filter-regulators, lubricators, soft-start valves, pressure gauges, air dryers, auto drains, silencers, blow guns (HS 8421.39 filters/air dryers; 8481.80 regulators; 9026.20 pressure gauges); (4) Fittings & tubing — one-touch fittings, flow control, tubing, quick couplers, manifolds (HS 3917.31/3917.40 plastics; 8481.80 check valves); (5) Vacuum products — pads, ejectors, vacuum switches/regulators (HS 8414.90/8481.80/9026.20); (6) Fluid control — process valves, process pumps, high-purity products, industrial filters, electro-pneumatic positioners, sintered metal elements (HS 8481.80, 8413.x, 8421.39); (7) Sensors & switches — pressure switches, vacuum switches, flow switches, auto switches, temperature/humidity switches (HS 9032.81 pneumatic/electric automatic regulating instruments; 9026.20 pressure; 9026.10 flow); (8) Static control/ionizers, temperature control (circulating fluid temperature controllers, thermoelectric baths), high-vacuum angle/slit valves (HS 8481.80, 8419.x, 8543.70).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — SMC Corporation is a global manufacturer of pneumatic components; the Indian private limited entity combines local assembly/manufacture with import-and-distribute of the parent's Japanese product range. Trader signs: catalogue is the global SMC range, not an India-specific manufactured list; no India-specific product page could be opened (smcworld.com/en-in returns 404, smcworld.com root returns 403), so the India entity's own catalogue is not independently verifiable.
comment: HS 9026.90 is only partially correct. 9026.90 is the residual/parts subheading for instruments measuring flow, level, pressure or other variables — it fits only the pressure/flow/vacuum switch and gauge segment (a minority of the range). The bulk of SMC's declared product line is pneumatic machinery and valves, which belong in Chapter 84: 8412.31 (pneumatic linear actuators/cylinders), 8412.39 (other pneumatic actuators, rotary/grippers), 8481.20 (valves for pneumatic power transmission — solenoid/ directional control valves), 8481.80 (regulators, filter-regulators, check valves, quick couplers, process valves), 8421.39 (air filters/dryers), 9032.81 (automatic regulating/controlling instruments, pneumatic), 9026.20 (pressure gauges/switches), 9026.10 (flow switches). Plastics tubing/fittings 3917.31/3917.40 also appear. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the actual Chapter 84/90 mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry misclassification: declared industry 'IT и электроника' is wrong — SMC is industrial automation / fluid power (pneumatics, valves, air treatment), not IT or consumer electronics; the electronics link is limited to solenoid coils and sensor/switch electronics. Product lines missing from the declaration: pneumatic cylinders and actuators, solenoid/directional control valves, airline treatment equipment (FRL units, dryers), fittings and tubing, vacuum equipment, process pumps and valves, ionizers/static control, temperature control equipment. All product identifications above are from the SMC corporate catalogue taxonomy (smc.eu/en-eu, read directly) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the level of the Indian entity's own shipments — no customs line was available to this researcher (registry/customs research out of scope per role). Note: the input name field merges four name variants ('M/S S M C PNEUMATICS INDIA PVT LTD' vs 'SMC CORPORATION (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED'); these may be two distinct legal entities (an older/renamed pneumatics entity and the current SMC India entity) and should be de-duplicated before the batch is finalised. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data collected or asserted (null / not researched per role).
